name: Introduction and overview — Ford GT40 (1964-1969) — car record
title: Introduction and overview — Ford GT40 (1964-1969)
description: Introduction and overview of the Ford GT40 (1964-1969): What this car is, its place in automotive history, and why collectors care. The Ford GT40 was built for revenge after Ferrari rebuffed Ford's buyout: it won Le Mans four straight years (1966-69), with the 1966 1-2-3 finish the most famous. 105 were built; the 7.0-liter Mk II and Mk IV versions hit 210+ mph on the Mulsanne. The GT40 is America's greatest racing car. Baseline facts: American racer 1964-1969; 105 built by Ford; four straight Le Mans wins..
